messages.landing.bottom.heading: Get started
messages.landing.bottom.premium_note: The bot takes reservations only on premium servers. A new server stays inactive until premium is turned on.
messages.landing.bottom.sub: Add Letter to your Discord server, then sign in to set ranks and channels.
messages.landing.feature.channels.desc: Choose one channel for /book and one for the summary. Anyone who books elsewhere is told where to go.
messages.landing.feature.channels.name: Channels
messages.landing.feature.characters.desc: Level, vocation, guild and last login of every booked character, straight from TibiaData.
messages.landing.feature.characters.name: Characters
messages.landing.feature.reservations.desc: Book a respawn with /book or in the panel. Overlapping bookings are refused, and managers can edit or cancel any reservation.
messages.landing.feature.reservations.name: Reservations
messages.landing.feature.roles.desc: Pick which Discord roles manage respawns, which can book and which may overbook. Server admins always keep full control.
messages.landing.feature.roles.name: Ranks & permissions
messages.landing.feature.stats.desc: Booked hours per respawn and player, and experience per hour from the TibiaData highscores.
messages.landing.feature.stats.name: Stats & experience
messages.landing.feature.summary.desc: A live schedule of upcoming reservations in the channel you pick, refreshed as soon as something changes.
messages.landing.feature.summary.name: Discord summary
messages.landing.features.heading: Everything your respawn schedule needs
messages.landing.features.sub: The bot works in your Discord server, the panel keeps the settings and the numbers. You decide who can book, where and for how long.
messages.landing.hero.sub: Letter handles respawn reservations for your Tibia guild. Members book with /book, the bot keeps a live schedule in your Discord server, and the panel gives you ranks, channels and stats.
messages.landing.meta.description: Letter is a Discord bot and web panel for Tibia respawn reservations: book with /book, see the schedule on Discord, set ranks and channels, and follow stats and experience per respawn and player.
messages.landing.meta.title: Letter: Tibia respawn reservations for your Discord server
messages.landing.tools.heading: Tools that just open. No account.
messages.landing.tools.sub: Split the loot of a hunt between your party in seconds. You need no Discord server and no login.
messages.premium.required.message: Letter is inactive on %s. The bot takes reservations and posts the summary only on premium servers. Contact the Letter team to activate premium.
messages.premium.required.title: Premium required
messages.range.picker.hint_days: Tap a day to add or remove it.
messages.range.picker.hint_range: Tap the first day, then the last day.
messages.settings.page.heading: Settings
messages.settings.page.lede: Set the Tibia world of %s and select who may view, reserve, overbook and manage.
messages.settings.page.title: Settings - %s
messages.settings.premium.body: This server is not premium. The bot answers commands with a short notice and posts no summary. You can prepare the settings now. They apply when premium is on.
messages.settings.premium.heading: The bot is inactive on this server
messages.settings.ranks.manage.body: Members with a checked rank can manage respawns and all reservations. They cannot open Settings or Channels. The server owner and administrators can always manage.
messages.settings.ranks.manage.empty: None checked: only the server owner and administrators can manage.
messages.settings.ranks.manage.heading: Manage ranks
messages.settings.ranks.overbook.body: Members with a checked rank can overbook: book a respawn that another member holds. This shortens or removes the other reservation, and the bot sends that member a message. Managers and administrators can always overbook.
messages.settings.ranks.overbook.empty: None checked: members with the @Postman role can overbook.
messages.settings.ranks.overbook.heading: Overbook ranks
messages.settings.ranks.reserve.body: Members with a checked rank can book respawns, with /book on Discord and on this site. Members who can reserve can also view.
messages.settings.ranks.reserve.empty: None checked: everyone on the server can reserve.
messages.settings.ranks.reserve.heading: Reserve ranks
messages.settings.ranks.view.body: Members with a checked rank can sign in and see reservations, respawns and stats. They cannot book unless they can also reserve.
messages.settings.ranks.view.empty: None checked: only members who can reserve, and managers, can view.
messages.settings.ranks.view.heading: View-only ranks
messages.settings.refresh.body: The bot copies the channels and roles of this server for these pages. Refresh when a new channel or role is missing.
messages.settings.refresh.cooldown: A refresh was requested recently. Try again in %d min.
messages.settings.refresh.heading: Server data
messages.settings.refresh.requested: Refresh requested. Reload this page in a few seconds.
messages.settings.reinvite.body: Is a permission missing (for example, the bot cannot create its channels or the Postman role)? Invite the bot again to apply the permissions. The bot stays in the server. Only its permissions change.
messages.settings.reinvite.heading: Bot permissions
messages.settings.stale: A selected role is no longer on the server. Reload this page and try again.
messages.settings.sync.no_roles: No roles copied yet. Use %s at the top of this page, then reload this page.
messages.settings.sync.roles_hint: Roles are copied from Discord. If one is missing, use %s at the top of this page.
messages.settings.world.body: The summary shows which players of this world are online. This is the same setting as the /world-set command.
messages.settings.world.heading: Tibia world
messages.settings.world.invalid: Select a world from the list.
messages.shell.admin.heading: Admin

messages.spots.flash.not_found: This respawn does not exist any more. The list is up to date now.
messages.spots.flash.restore_clash: This respawn cannot be restored: an active respawn has the same name. Rename that one first.
